verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a single Parse endpoint that converts documents to structured JSON. Its pricing page claims "30+ Supported File Types," and an uploaded file's reducto:// identifier can be passed to any downstream endpoint, which suggests format-agnostic handling. However, the pack never lists which formats are supported; only PDF (quickstart) and DOCX (edit) are named, so most of the story's format mix is unverified. missing for 10: explicit documentation of PPTX, XLSX, HTML, image and email support through the same endpoint, a published supported-format list, independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.

support.subject: As a developer, one API handles my whole document mix — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email — without per-format plumbing

citations.quote: Parse is Reducto's foundational endpoint. It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
returning a unique `reducto://` identifier you can pass to any downstream endpoint: Classify, Parse, Split, Extract, or Edit.
Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions.
